notes.title: Biorage 1.1 UPDATE
notes.notes: [p]Hello![/p][p][/p][p]It's time for some biorage![/p][p][/p][p]The next few days, I'll be posting daily stuff about this game like sales, wishlists, opinions, speedrun strategy's etc as a sort of resurgence you might say.[/p][p][/p][p]Anyways today a quick little hotfix.[/p][p][/p][p]-- Tried to fix a shotgun bug that caused the game to crash after shooting it in chapter 1 level 3. (if it does still crash for some reason, a simple restart will 100 percent fix it)[/p][p][/p][p]-- Fixed the UI sprite for the "Random Mode" not appearing in the Extra Modes menu.[/p][p][/p][p]Update size: 47,6MB[/p][p][/p][p][/p]
